brief: Per-role policy pack from the SessionStart hook (owner ruling tvofi 2026-10-24, recommendation (b) of the token pre-study). Today every seat opens by re-reading CLAUDE.md, its role contract and tools/audit/seat/INSTRUMENTS.md with tool calls, which re-sends the same text in each seat's context. Change: a new module under tools/policy renders, for a named role (fixer, fix-review, designer, design-review, root-cause, verifier, judge, and the finder's COMMON.md), one pack made of the verbatim text of CLAUDE.md, that role's contract under dev/governance/roles/, the rules under dev/governance/rules/ whose paths: globs the role's files match, and only the INSTRUMENTS.md entries for the instruments the role's contract names. The in-tree SessionStart hook .claude/hooks/session-start.sh prints the pack when the role environment variable is set, after its existing clone-fact lines, and prints nothing extra when it is unset, so the main session and every other clone are unchanged. cloud_dispatch.py (R10-FLOW-DESIGN-STAGES) sets the variable in the cloud payload for each role it renders; a seat launched without it reads the files as today. Measure first: the tokens a fixer, a reviewer and a designer spend on the policy re-read at the base, from the local session transcripts (the token section of R10-FLOW-BOARD is the reader if it has landed; otherwise count the Read results of those files in a sample of seat transcripts); the change is justified by that number falling, with the pack's own size beside it. Controls: the pack for a role contains every line of its contract (byte-equal), and a file removed from the role's list fails the check; with the variable unset the hook output is byte-equal to today's; a pack never exceeds the policy files' current text (it is a subset); each rule has a mutant. Open point, not decided here: Agent-tool subagents launched inside a local session may not run SessionStart at all. Measure that at the base. If they do not, the local seat brief carries the pack path instead, and say so in the handoff rather than claiming the saving for local seats.
